text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
The Make Debut had arrived. Expectations 
were soaring for Duramente. She declared 
that she would prove the greatness of her 
bloodline.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
However, the moment she entered the 
waiting room... she visibly tensed up. The 
weight of expectations had clearly turned 
into heavy pressure.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
I told her, "It's okay not to be perfect 
at first." —Words passed down from her 
father.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Those words relieved her tension, and 
Duramente headed toward her debut race 
with a composed demeanor.
